description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to tenant ID encryption and decryption, including validation of tenant salt, AES encryption/decryption, and salt handling, using the CryptoJS library.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates that a string appears to be URL-safe base64 without padding, with length approximately 22-24 characters.

methods.name: stripBase64Padding
methods.description: Removes trailing '=' padding characters from a base64 string.

methods.name: toWordArray
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array or Buffer into a CryptoJS WordArray.

methods.name: deriveAes128KeyFromBase64UrlSalt
methods.description: Derives a 128-bit AES key from a base64url-encoded salt by decoding, hashing with SHA256, and taking the first 16 bytes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt appears to be a valid URL-safe base64 string without padding.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using AES-128-ECB with a key derived from the tenant salt; returns base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted tenant ID back to plaintext using the same AES scheme.

methods.name: setTenantEncryptionSalt
methods.description: A no-op function that indicates the tenant salt is fixed by configuration; retained for API parity.
